title: StickyLoot
description: Break any block → get a random item. 1235 possible items. Sticky & Pure Random Mode.
body: StickyLoot is a Minecraft randomizer survival mod that replaces normal block drops with over 1235 possible random items. Choose Sticky Mode with persistent mappings or Pure Random Mode for chaotic survival and SMP challenges. Fully multiplayer compatible, NeoForge supported and server ready.
